installation.name: Creating launcher script
commands:
python -c "f=open('launch.py','w');f.write('import subprocess, sys, os, time
BASE = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
ACESTEP_DIR = os.path.join(BASE, "ACE-Step-1.5")
SERVER_DIR = os.path.join(BASE, "server")
env_api = os.environ.copy()
env_api["MASTER_ADDR"] = "127.0.0.1"
env_api["VLLM_HOST_IP"] = "127.0.0.1"
env_api["ACESTEP_LM_BACKEND"] = "pt"
env_api["ACESTEP_LM_OFFLOAD_TO_CPU"] = "true"
VENV_PYTHON = os.path.join(BASE, "..", "env", "Scripts", "python.exe") if os.name == "nt" else os.path.join(BASE, "..", "env", "bin", "python")
env_server = os.environ.copy()
env_server["PORT"] = "3001"
env_server["PYTHON_PATH"] = os.path.abspath(VENV_PYTHON)
env_server["ACESTEP_API_URL"] = "http://127.0.0.1:8001"
env_server["NODE_ENV"] = "development"
env_server["DATABASE_PATH"] = "./data/acestep.db"
env_server["AUDIO_DIR"] = "./public/audio"
env_server["FRONTEND_URL"] = "http://127.0.0.1:3000"
env_server["ACESTEP_PATH"] = ACESTEP_DIR
env_server["JWT_SECRET"] = "ace-step-ui-local-secret"
procs = []
try:
    print("Starting ACE-Step API...")
    DEVNULL = open(os.devnull, "w")
    p1 = subprocess.Popen(["acestep", "--port", "8001", "--enable-api", "--backend", "pt", "--server-name", "127.0.0.1"], cwd=ACESTEP_DIR, env=env_api, stdout=DEVNULL, stderr=DEVNULL)
    procs.append(p1)
    time.sleep(30)
    print("Starting frontend on port 3000...")
    p2 = subprocess.Popen(["npm", "run", "dev", "--", "--host", "127.0.0.1", "--port", "3000", "--strictPort"], cwd=BASE, shell=True)
    procs.append(p2)
    time.sleep(5)
    print("Starting backend server on port 3001...")
    p3 = subprocess.Popen(["npm", "run", "dev"], cwd=SERVER_DIR, env=env_server, shell=True)
    procs.append(p3)
    time.sleep(5)
    print("ACE-Step UI Server running")
    p1.wait()
except KeyboardInterrupt:
    pass
finally:
    for p in procs:
        p.terminate()
');f.close()"
